We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions. The guidance mentions Sn2, Friedel-Crafts acylation, substitution to replace OH with halogen. So likely three steps: 1) SN2 to attach something (maybe the side chain with N4CC(F)C4). 2) Friedel-Crafts acylation to install amide linking to heterocycle. 3) substitution to convert OH to halide earlier.

We need to produce JSON with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc. Need template IDs. We can search for templates matching these reaction types. Use search without bond criteria. Let's search for SN2 template.
